reason: Our ERP vendor already gives us a student app with notices, and faculty WhatsApp groups reach students instantly at zero cost. I cannot walk into a trustee meeting asking for ₹9 lakh a year for a second feed when I can't show it fixes a problem we're actually measuring.
objection: This duplicates what the ERP app is supposed to do, and I'd be handing Microsoft 365 and ERP access to a small startup I've never heard of. If they shut down in two years I'm left explaining a data-access approval and a dead app to the committee.
would_change_my_mind: A pilot report showing a clear, verified drop in missed submissions versus our ERP app plus WhatsApp, with references from two or three comparable Indian private universities already paying for it.
